name: 예영

tips.단·복수: many, there are 뒤에는 복수형(-s). clothes는 항상 복수예요.
tips.주어-동사: he/she/it/the city → has, is. people → are, love. 동사는 하나만!
tips.동사·시제: 진행형은 be + -ing, 과거 질문엔 과거형, 부정은 don't / doesn't.
tips.문장 구조: 한 문장에 동사는 하나! need to / have to 뒤에는 동사, 명사는 바로 need / have.
tips.관사·전치사: 처음 말하는 집은 a house, 바다는 the beach. go on holiday, on a rainy day.
tips.품사: be 뒤에는 형용사: confident, dead, scary. 명사를 꾸밀 때도 형용사: active sports.
tips.단어 선택: 한국어를 그대로 옮기지 말고 영어에서 쓰는 짝꿍 표현으로.
tips.발음·철자: walk(r 소리 없음) / work(r 소리). 철자는 소리 내어 한 번 더.

focus.10: 과거 질문엔 끝까지 과거형! 장소 앞 관사(the beach)와 전치사(on holiday) 챙기기.
focus.11: 동명사 주어(Making a list, Being punctual)는 단수 동사! annoying(그게 주는 느낌) vs annoyed(내 기분) 구분하기.
focus.12: 처음 소개할 땐 There is a ~, 다시 말할 땐 It! 동명사 주어(Drinking water, Having a routine)는 단수 동사.
focus.13: help + 사람 + 동사원형 (is help ✕)! go to + 장소, similar to. 동사를 꾸밀 땐 부사(more easily).

compare: used to vs be used to

I used to play the recorder. ~하곤 했다 (+동사원형)
I'm used to getting up early. ~에 익숙하다 (+ing)
talk with 사람 · say + 말한 내용 · tell + 사람 + 내용 · speak + 언어
6 months ago 전에 · for 6 months 동안 · in 6 months 후에
그게 주는 느낌은 -ing: The work is exhausting · 내 기분은 -ed: I'm exhausted
outdoor 형용사: outdoor activities · outdoors 부사: I like being outdoors
even ~조차, 심지어: even on weekends, even better · ever 한 번이라도: Have you ever ~? / the best I've ever had / hardly ever

cards.en: There are many companies.
cards.gram:
수가 여러 개면 there are + 복수명사. many 뒤에는 꼭 -s를 붙여요: companies.
there is vs there are · 하나면 there is a company, 여러 개면 there are many companies. there is many는 틀려요.

cards.en: There are many parks near my house.
cards.mine: There are many park near my house.
cards.gram:
many 뒤에는 복수형: park → parks. 복수니까 there are.
near vs nearby · near는 뒤에 장소가 와요: near my house. nearby는 혼자 쓰거나 명사 앞에: There's a park nearby. / a nearby park. nearby my house는 틀려요.
더 자세히 · which로 설명을 덧붙여요: There's a park nearby, which is a one-minute walk from my house.

cards.en: I bought some clothes.
cards.gram: clothes는 늘 복수라서 a를 못 붙여요. '좀'이라는 느낌은 some clothes.

cards.en: The house has a garden.
cards.gram: 주어가 the house(하나)라서 have가 아니라 has. he/she/it에는 has!

cards.en: The city has many schools.
cards.mine: The city have a many school.
cards.gram: the city는 하나라서 has. many 뒤 명사는 복수: schools. a many는 안 돼요.

cards.en: There are many cafes here.
cards.gram: here is로 시작하지 말고 There are + 복수명사 + here. cafes가 여러 개니까 are.

cards.en: It has many restaurants.
cards.gram:
동사는 하나만! It's(It is) + have를 같이 쓰면 안 돼요. It has many restaurants.
a many ❌ · many 앞에는 a를 안 붙여요. a lot of는 OK: It has a lot of restaurants.

cards.en: I'm living in Canada.
cards.gram: 지금 살고 있는 중이면 진행형 be + -ing. be동사를 빼먹지 않기: I'm living.

cards.en: I'm interested in sports.
cards.gram:
interested는 형용사라 be동사가 필요해요. I'm interested in + 관심 있는 것.
interested vs interesting · 내 기분은 interested: I'm interested in art. / 대상이 재밌으면 interesting: Art is interesting.

cards.en: I don't work.
cards.gram:
일반동사 부정은 don't + 동사. I no work는 틀린 형태예요.
be동사 vs 일반동사 · I'm not a student. / I don't work. 동사 종류에 따라 not 자리가 달라요.

cards.en: I moved to Canada last year.
cards.mine: I'm moving to the Canada last year.
cards.gram:
last year가 있으면 과거형 moved. 나라 이름 Canada 앞에는 the를 안 붙여요.
이미 한 일은 과거형 · I'm moving은 '이사 가는 중·이사할 예정'이에요. 이미 이사 왔으면 I moved.

cards.ko: 저는 일어나면 물을 한 잔 마셔요.
cards.en: When I wake up, I drink a cup of water.
cards.mine: When I waking up, I drink one water.
cards.gram:
when 뒤에도 주어 + 동사가 제대로 와야 해요: When I wake up. 물은 셀 수 없어서 a cup of water.
셀 수 없는 명사 · one water ❌ → a glass of water, a cup of coffee, a piece of advice. water, money, information, advice엔 -s도 안 붙여요.

cards.en: I started yoga last month.
cards.gram:
last month(지난달)이니까 과거형 started. I'm start처럼 be동사를 붙이지 않아요.
be동사 + 동사원형 ❌ · I'm start / I'm go처럼 섞지 않기. 과거는 I started, 지금 막 시작하는 참이면 I'm starting.

cards.ko: 저는 주택에 사는 걸 더 좋아해요.
cards.en: I prefer living in a house.
cards.gram:
prefer + -ing(~하는 걸 더 좋아하다). 주택은 a house로 관사까지.
prefer 뒤에 오는 것 · 명사: I prefer a house. / 동사: I prefer living in a house. = I prefer to live in a house. prefer to house처럼 to + 명사는 틀려요.

cards.en: I like to wear T-shirts.
cards.gram:
like 뒤에 동사가 오면 like to wear 또는 like wearing. 티셔츠 일반을 말할 땐 복수 T-shirts.
동사 두 개 붙이지 않기 · like wear ❌ → like to wear / like wearing. 동사 뒤에 또 동사가 오면 to나 -ing로 연결해요.

cards.en: My city needs more parks.
cards.mine: My city needs to more parks.
cards.gram:
need to 뒤에는 동사가 와요. 명사가 필요할 땐 to 없이 needs more parks. city가 단수라 needs.
need vs need to · need + 명사: My city needs more parks. / need to + 동사: We need to build more parks.

cards.en: I have responsibilities at work.
cards.mine: I have to responsibility at work.
cards.gram:
have to 뒤에는 동사! 명사(책임)를 가졌다고 할 땐 have responsibilities.
have vs have to · have + 명사: I have many responsibilities. / have to + 동사: I have to manage the team.

cards.en: It makes me feel relaxed.
cards.mine: It is make me feel relaxed.
cards.gram:
동사 두 개 겹치지 않기. is + make가 아니라 It makes me feel relaxed.
make + 사람 + 동사원형 · It makes me feel happy. / It makes me laugh. make 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형이에요.

cards.en: I visited Vietnam.
cards.gram: 나라 이름 앞에는 보통 the를 안 붙여요. the는 the US, the UK처럼 연합·복수형 나라만.

cards.en: I want to live in a house.
cards.mine: I want to live in the house.
cards.gram:
처음 말하는 집은 특정한 집이 아니니까 a house.
a vs the · 처음 꺼낼 땐 a: I live in a house. 다시 말할 땐 the: The house has a garden.

cards.en: I stay home on a rainy day.
cards.mine: I stay home in a rainy day.
cards.gram:
특정한 날 앞에는 on: on a rainy day, on Monday, on my birthday.
더 써보기 · on the days I feel exhausted = 지치는 날에는. 다음 날은 the next day: Sleeping well helps me recover the next day.

cards.en: I like active sports.
cards.gram: sports를 꾸미는 건 형용사 active. activity sports라고는 하지 않아요. 활동적인 = 형용사 active.

cards.en: My plant is dead.
cards.gram:
die는 동사(죽다), dead는 형용사(죽은 상태). be동사 뒤에는 형용사!
die vs dead · 죽었다(사건): My plant died. / 죽어 있다(상태): My plant is dead. is die는 틀려요.

cards.en: Korea is my country.
cards.gram: Korea는 나라, Korean은 한국 사람·한국어·한국의.

cards.en: I made a reservation at the restaurant.
cards.mine: I made a reserve at the restaurant.
cards.gram: reserve는 동사, reservation은 명사. make a reservation이 짝꿍 표현.

cards.ko: 더 자신감 있는 사람이 되고 싶어요.
cards.en: I want to be more confident.
cards.mine: I want to be more confidence.
cards.gram: be 뒤에는 형용사 confident. confidence는 명사(자신감).

cards.en: The movie was scary.
cards.gram:
scary는 무서운 대상(영화가 무섭다), scared는 무서워하는 감정(내가 무섭다).
scare · scared · scary · scare(동사): The movie scared me. / scared(내 기분): I was scared. / scary(대상): The movie was scary.

cards.en: We have to understand and support each other.
cards.mine: We have to have each other.
cards.gram: have each other는 어색해요. 서로 돕는다는 뜻은 understand and support each other.

cards.en: I go travelling every summer.
cards.mine: I go to travel every summer.
cards.gram:
go + -ing = ~하러 가다: go travelling, go shopping. go to travel은 어색해요.
go on vs go -ing · 명사 앞엔 go on: go on holiday / go on a trip. -ing 앞엔 go만: go travelling / go sightseeing.

cards.en: I take the bus to work.
cards.mine: I use a bus to go to work.
cards.gram:
교통수단은 use가 아니라 take: take a bus, take the subway.
더 자연스럽게 · I go to work by bus. / I take the bus to work. 걸어가면 I walk to work.

cards.ko: 그 일에 대해 많은 사람들과 이야기했어요.
cards.en: I talked with many people about it.
cards.mine: I talked many people about it.
cards.gram:
사람과 이야기할 땐 talk with/to + 사람. 주제는 about으로.
talk about vs talk with · talk about + 주제: talk about the trip. / talk with + 사람: talk with my friend. talk about many people은 '많은 사람에 대해' 이야기한 거예요.

cards.ko: 그녀가 저에게 그 이야기를 해 줬어요.
cards.en: She told me the story.
cards.gram:
say 뒤에는 사람이 바로 못 와요. 사람에게 말해 줄 땐 tell + 사람 + 내용.
say · tell · talk · speak · say + 말: She said hello. / tell + 사람: She told me. / talk + about·with: We talked about it. / speak + 언어: I speak English.

cards.en: walk (r 소리 없음) / work (r 소리)
cards.gram: walk는 l이 소리 나지 않고 '워-크', work는 혀를 굴려 r 소리를 내요.

cards.en: I'm not a picky eater.
cards.gram: picky eater = 편식하는 사람. 부정은 I'm not a picky eater.

cards.ko: 나는 요가할 때 물 만난 물고기 같아
cards.en: I'm in my element when I do yoga.
cards.gram: in my element = 물 만난 물고기, 제일 나다운 상태. 좋아하는 활동 말할 때 딱이에요.

cards.ko: 그 책은 생각할 거리를 많이 줘
cards.en: The book gives me a lot of food for thought.
cards.gram: food for thought = 생각할 거리. 책·영화·강의 이야기할 때 써요.

cards.en: I want to brush up on my English.
cards.gram: brush up on = 녹슨 실력을 다시 다듬다. on까지 함께 외우기.

cards.en: I took up yoga last year.
cards.gram: take up = 새 취미를 시작하다. 과거는 took up.

cards.en: It's a 10-minute walk.
cards.gram:
거리를 시간으로 말할 때 It's a 10-minute walk. minute은 단수로 붙여 써요.
같은 뜻 다른 표현 · It takes 10 minutes on foot. 이땐 minutes 복수예요. 차로는 It's a 10-minute drive.

cards.en: I leave early to beat the traffic.
cards.gram: beat the traffic = 차 막히는 시간을 피하다.

cards.en: I'm trying to cut down on alcohol.
cards.gram: cut down on = ~을 줄이다. 끊는 건 give up, 줄이는 건 cut down on.

cards.en: We need to reduce carbon emissions.
cards.gram: 환경 주제 단골 표현: reduce carbon emissions(탄소 배출을 줄이다).

cards.en: We should switch to renewable energy.
cards.gram: switch to = ~로 바꾸다. renewable energy(재생 에너지)와 짝꿍.

cards.en: All of a sudden, my mind went blank.
cards.gram: all of a sudden = 갑자기. my mind went blank = 머리가 하얘졌다.

cards.en: It's not a magic bullet.
cards.gram: magic bullet = 만능 해결책. 보통 부정문으로 써요: It's not a magic bullet.

cards.ko: 그는 처음에 좀 깐깐한 인상을 줬어
cards.en: He came across as a bit strict at first.
cards.gram: come across as + 형용사 = ~한 인상을 주다.

cards.en: I came up with a good idea.
cards.gram: come up with = (아이디어를) 떠올리다.

cards.en: Things didn't go to plan.
cards.gram: go to plan = 계획대로 되다. 보통 didn't go to plan으로 많이 써요.

cards.ko: 알고 보니 그 식당은 문을 닫았더라
cards.en: It turned out that the restaurant was closed.
cards.gram: It turned out that + 문장 = 알고 보니 ~였다.

cards.en: I'm used to getting up early.
cards.gram:
be used to + -ing = ~에 익숙하다. to 뒤에 -ing가 와요!
used to vs be used to · I used to get up early. (예전엔 그랬다) / I'm used to getting up early. (지금 익숙하다)

cards.ko: 나는 어릴 때 리코더를 불곤 했어
cards.en: I used to play the recorder.
cards.gram:
used to + 동사원형 = (예전에) ~하곤 했다. 지금은 안 한다는 느낌.
used to vs be used to · I used to play the recorder. (예전 습관) / I'm used to playing it. (익숙하다, -ing)

cards.en: It's likely to rain tomorrow.
cards.gram: be likely to + 동사 = ~할 것 같다. It's likely to rain.

cards.en: I'll go with the blue one.
cards.gram: go with = (여러 개 중에) ~로 정하다.

cards.en: The price has dropped a bit recently.
cards.gram: 최근에 떨어져서 지금 싼 상태라 현재완료 has dropped. a bit = 조금.

cards.ko: 내가 말했듯이, 나는 바다를 더 좋아해
cards.en: As I said, I prefer the beach.
cards.gram: 문장 앞 As = ~처럼, ~듯이. As I said / As usual.

cards.en: What's going on? Why is it so noisy?
cards.gram: What's going on? = 무슨 일이야? 놀라거나 궁금할 때.

cards.en: It's my safe haven.
cards.gram: safe haven = 안식처, 마음 편한 곳.

cards.en: I went on holiday a few days ago.
cards.gram: 휴가를 가다는 go on holiday로 통째로 외워요. 끝에 a few days ago(며칠 전)가 있으니 동사는 과거형 went예요.

cards.en: I went to the beach.
cards.gram: 해변, 바다, 산처럼 모두가 아는 장소 앞에는 the: the beach, the sea, the mountains. 내 이야기니까 주어는 I.

cards.en: I have a sweet tooth.
cards.gram: have a sweet tooth는 관용 표현이라 동사는 like가 아니라 have, 앞에 a도 꼭!

cards.en: People love sweets.
cards.gram: 한 문장에 동사는 하나만! is와 love를 같이 쓰면 안 돼요. people은 복수라 be동사라면 are.

cards.en: The weather affects my mood.
cards.gram: affect는 동사(영향을 주다), effect는 명사(영향). 주어가 3인칭 단수라 affects.

cards.en: It doesn't matter to me.
cards.gram: doesn't = does not. 여기서 matter는 '중요하다'라는 동사. 내 입장이니까 to me.

cards.en: I went to Hawaii six months ago.
cards.gram: 6 months ago 전에 · for 6 months 동안 · in 6 months 후에. 모르는 단어도 영어로: Hawaii.

cards.en: I want to go sightseeing.
cards.gram: go + -ing = ~하러 가다: go sightseeing, go shopping. want to 뒤에는 동사원형.

cards.en: It was really noisy.
cards.gram: noise(명사) → noisy(형용사). be동사 뒤에는 형용사! 과거 이야기라 was.

cards.en: I was discharged from the hospital.
cards.gram: be + 과거분사는 '~되다'. 퇴원은 from the hospital, 전역은 from the military.

cards.ko: 제가 기억하는 한, 그곳은 유명한 관광지였어요.
cards.en: As far as I remember, it was a famous tourist attraction.
cards.mine: as far as I remember · tourist attraction
cards.gram: As far as I remember는 문장 앞 덩어리 표현. 관광지는 tourist attraction, 여행지 전체는 tourist destination.

cards.ko: 저는 바다에 가는 걸 더 좋아해요.
cards.en: I prefer going to the beach.
cards.mine: I prefer going to the beach
cards.gram: prefer + -ing = ~하는 걸 더 좋아하다. 비교는 I prefer the beach to the mountains.

cards.ko: 우리는 같은 기수였어. 그녀는 내 입사 동기야.
cards.en: We were in the same batch. She is my batchmate.
cards.gram:
batch = 동기, 기수. in the same batch = 같은 기수(동기)인, batchmate = 동기 한 명.
batch vs classmate · 학교 같은 반은 classmate, 입학·입사 같은 기수는 batchmate.

cards.en: I usually sleep for six to seven hours.
cards.gram: 잠잔 시간은 sleep for + 시간. 'A~B시간'은 six to seven hours.

cards.en: It's not enough time.
cards.gram: '시간이 짧다'를 short time으로 직역하지 말고 not enough time / insufficient time.

cards.ko: 저는 아침보다 저녁에 더 집중할 수 있어요.
cards.en: I can concentrate more in the evening than in the morning.
cards.mine: I can more concentrate in the evening.
cards.gram: more는 동사 뒤로! concentrate more. 동사 concentrate / 명사 concentration.

cards.en: I try not to take a nap.
cards.gram: try not to + 동사원형 = ~하지 않으려고 하다. not의 위치는 to 앞!

cards.ko: 저는 보통 민트 사탕을 가지고 다녀요.
cards.en: I usually carry mints with me.
cards.gram: 가지고 다니다 = carry 물건 with me. 시원한 사탕은 mints.

cards.en: Many people have heavy workloads.
cards.gram: 작업량은 workload, 많으면 heavy. 여러 사람이니 workloads.

cards.en: I worked overtime today.
cards.gram: 야근하다 = work overtime. 오늘 이미 한 일이니 과거형 worked.

cards.ko: 목록을 작성하는 건 제가 시간 관리하는 걸 도와줘요.
cards.en: Making a list helps me manage my time.
cards.gram: 동명사 주어(Making a list)는 단수 → helps. help + 사람 + 동사원형.

cards.en: Being punctual is important.

cards.ko: 알고 보니 그 사람이 제 친구의 오빠였어요.
cards.en: It turned out he was my friend's brother.
cards.gram: turn out = 드러나다, 알고 보니 ~이다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.plabel: 단어장 복습 · what do you mean by ~?
cards.en: What do you mean by 'fine'?
cards.gram: what do you mean by ~? = ~가 무슨 말이야?. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.plabel: 단어장 복습 · most of the time
cards.en: Most of the time, I eat at home.
cards.gram: most of the time = 대부분. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: When the weather is nice, I exercise outdoors.
cards.gram: outdoors = 야외에서. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: I eat out once a week.
cards.gram: eat out = 외식하다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: He's a coffee expert.
cards.gram: expert = 전문가. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: This job needs expertise.
cards.gram: expertise = 전문지식. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.plabel: 단어장 복습 · have a hankering for something
cards.en: I suddenly have a hankering for tteokbokki.
cards.gram: have a hankering for something = ~을 갈망하다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.plabel: 단어장 복습 · make something out of thin air
cards.ko: 그녀는 아무것도 없는 데서 사업을 일궈냈어요.
cards.en: She made her business out of thin air.
cards.hint: make something out of thin air
cards.gram: make something out of thin air = 무에서 만들어내다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: I lost the file, so I started from scratch.
cards.gram: start from scratch = 처음부터 시작하다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: The island's scenery was ethereal.
cards.gram: ethereal = 비현실적인, 천상의. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: I'll go with the chocolate cake.
cards.gram: go with = ~로 하다(고르다). 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: The library is my safe haven.
cards.gram: safe haven = 안식처. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.plabel: 단어장 복습 · make the most of it
cards.en: My holiday is short, so I'll make the most of it.
cards.gram: make the most of it = 최대한 활용하다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: The traffic is likely to be bad today.
cards.gram: be likely to = ~할 가능성이 높다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: The temperature dropped a bit at the weekend.
cards.gram: drop a bit = 조금 떨어지다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: As usual, I started my day with coffee.
cards.gram: as usual = 평소처럼. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.ko: 밖이 왜 이렇게 시끄러워요? 무슨 일이에요?
cards.en: Why is it so noisy outside? What's going on?
cards.gram: What's going on? = 무슨 일이야?. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: My grandmother was discharged from the hospital yesterday.
cards.gram: be discharged = 퇴원하다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.plabel: 단어장 복습 · have a sweet tooth
cards.ko: 저는 단것을 좋아해서 디저트를 꼭 먹어요.
cards.en: I have a sweet tooth, so I always have dessert.
cards.gram: have a sweet tooth = 단것을 좋아하다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: The tower is a famous tourist attraction.
cards.gram: tourist attraction = 관광지. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: The film's story was intriguing.
cards.gram: intriguing = 흥미를 끄는. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: I don't pick up calls when I'm driving.
cards.gram: pick up calls = 전화를 받다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.plabel: 단어장 복습 · don't take it to heart
cards.ko: 그 말은 너무 마음에 담아 두지 마세요.
cards.en: Don't take what he said to heart.
cards.gram: don't take it to heart = 마음에 담아 두지 마. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.ko: 하루 종일 서 있는 건 정말 지쳐요. 그래서 저는 지쳤어요.
cards.en: Standing all day is exhausting, so I'm exhausted.
cards.gram: exhausting / exhausted = 지치게 하는 / 지친. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.ko: 알람 소리가 짜증 나요. 저는 짜증이 났어요.
cards.en: The alarm sound is annoying, and I'm annoyed.
cards.gram: annoying / annoyed = 짜증 나게 하는 / 짜증 난. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: My room is a mess. It's really messy.
cards.gram: mess / messy = 엉망 / 지저분한. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: I can concentrate well in cafés.
cards.gram: concentrate / concentration = 집중하다 / 집중(력). 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: I keep putting off my homework.
cards.gram: put off = 미루다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: My workload is too heavy this week.
cards.gram: workload = 작업량. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.plabel: 단어장 복습 · come across / run into
cards.en: I ran into an old friend at the supermarket.
cards.gram: come across / run into = 우연히 마주치다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: First impressions are really important.
cards.gram: impression = 인상. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.en: I worked overtime yesterday.
cards.gram: work overtime = 야근하다. 내 단어장 단어로 만든 새 문장이에요.

cards.ko: 그건 제 영어 실력을 늘리는 데 도움이 돼요.
cards.en: It helps me improve my English.
cards.mine: It is help me improving English.
cards.gram: is와 help를 같이 쓰지 않기(동사는 하나!). help + 사람 + 동사원형 = ~가 …하도록 돕다.

cards.ko: 저는 팟캐스트를 들으면서 강아지 산책을 시켜요.
cards.en: I walk my dog while I listen to the podcast.
cards.mine: I walking a dog while I listening the podcast.
cards.gram: 주어 뒤엔 동사(현재형): I walk, I listen. 듣다는 listen to. walk my dog = 강아지를 산책시키다.

cards.ko: 하루 루틴이 있으면 제 삶이 더 풍요롭고 활기차져요.
cards.en: Having a daily routine makes my life richer and more vibrant.
cards.mine: Daily routine makes my life more active life.
cards.gram: 동명사 주어 Having a daily routine + makes(단수). make + 목적어 + 형용사 = ~를 …하게 만들다. vibrant = 활기찬, 생기 넘치는. life를 두 번 쓰지 않기.

cards.en: I have some time to myself in the evening.
cards.gram: time to myself = 나만의 시간. (I have my personal time도 OK)

cards.ko: 물을 마시는 건 제 몸에 좋아요.
cards.en: Drinking water is good for my body.
cards.mine: Drinking water is helpful by body.
cards.gram: good for / helpful for + 대상. 또는 Drinking water helps my body function well.

cards.ko: 우리 집 근처에 버스 정류장이 있어요.
cards.en: There is a bus stop near my home.
cards.mine: Bus stop is nearby my home.
cards.gram: 처음 꺼낼 땐 There is a ~. near + 장소 / nearby는 혼자(There's a bus stop nearby).

cards.en: There is a shop known for its delicious sandwiches.
cards.gram: There is 뒤엔 먼저 명사(a shop)! known for ~ = ~로 유명한. its(그것의) ≠ it's(it is).

cards.ko: 당신 말에 동의하지 않는 것 같아요.
cards.en: I don't think I agree with you.
cards.gram: 영어는 부정을 앞으로: I don't think + 문장 = ~인 것 같지 않아요.

cards.ko: 결국 케이크를 너무 많이 사게 됐어요.
cards.en: I ended up buying too much cake.
cards.gram: end up + -ing = 결국 ~하게 되다. cake는 덩어리로 말할 땐 much.

cards.ko: 이미 케이크가 많았는데, 케이크를 더 샀어요.
cards.en: We already had a lot of cake, but I bought even more cake.
cards.mine: I even bought a lot of cake.
cards.gram: even more = 훨씬 더. I even bought ~은 '~까지 샀다'(산 사실 강조)라는 느낌이에요.

cards.en: Even though it was raining, we went for a walk.
cards.gram: even though + 문장 = 비록 ~지만. even은 혼자 '~조차, ~까지'.

cards.en: He works even at the weekend.
cards.gram: even = ~조차, ~까지도 (단어 앞에). 문장을 붙일 땐 even though.

cards.ko: 제 친구도 단 걸 정말 좋아해요.
cards.en: My friend has a sweet tooth as well.
cards.gram: have a sweet tooth = 단 걸 좋아하다 + as well(~도).

cards.ko: 내일은 비가 안 올 것 같아요.
cards.en: I don't think it will rain tomorrow.
cards.gram: I don't think + 문장 = ~할 것 같지 않아요. ❌ I think it won't rain보다 자연스러워요.

cards.ko: 그건 좋은 생각이 아닌 것 같아요.
cards.en: I don't think that's a good idea.
cards.gram: 부드럽게 반대할 때: I don't think that's a good idea.

cards.ko: 오늘 밤엔 그걸 끝낼 수 없을 것 같아요.
cards.en: I don't think I can finish it tonight.
cards.gram: I don't think I can ~ = ~ 못 할 것 같아요.

cards.ko: 잠깐 쉬려고 했는데 결국 두 시간 동안 잤어요.
cards.en: I was going to take a short break, but I ended up sleeping for two hours.
cards.gram: end up + -ing = (계획과 달리) 결국 ~하게 되다.

cards.ko: 원래 집에 있으려고 했는데 결국 친구들이랑 나갔어요.
cards.en: I was planning to stay home, but I ended up going out with my friends.
cards.gram: was planning to ~, but ended up -ing = ~하려 했는데 결국 …했다.

cards.ko: 우리는 결국 그 식당에서 저녁을 먹게 됐어요.
cards.en: We ended up having dinner at that restaurant.
cards.gram: end up + -ing. 장소가 오면 end up at/in ~도 가능: We ended up at a café.

cards.ko: 저는 시거나 쓴 맛은 별로라서, 보통 짭짤한 음식이나 진한 초콜릿 케이크를 골라요.
cards.en: I'm not a fan of sour or bitter flavours, so I usually go for something savoury or a rich chocolate cake.
cards.gram: 맛 형용사: sour 신 · bitter 쓴 · savoury 짭짤한, 감칠맛 나는(단맛의 반대) · rich 진한, 깊은. I'm not a fan of ~ = ~는 별로예요. go for = 고르다.

cards.ko: 그냥 산책하려고 나갔는데, 결국 쇼핑몰에 가게 됐어요.
cards.en: I just went out for a walk, but I ended up at the mall.
cards.gram: end up at + 장소 = 결국 ~에 가게 되다. 동작이 오면 end up + -ing (ended up shopping).

cards.ko: 팟캐스트를 듣는 것은 제 영어에 도움이 돼요.
cards.en: Listening to podcasts helps me improve my English.
cards.gram: 동명사 주어 Listening to podcasts + helps(단수). help + 사람 + 동사원형.

cards.ko: 이 가게는 짭짤하고 바삭한 샌드위치로 잘 알려져 있어요.
cards.en: This shop is well known for its savoury, crispy sandwiches.
cards.gram: be well known for + 명사 = ~로 잘 알려져 있다. its = 그 가게의. savoury 짭짤한 / crispy 바삭한.

cards.ko: 우리 집 근처에 카페가 꽤 많고, 그 카페들의 커피는 맛이 깊어요.
cards.en: There are quite a few cafés near my home, and their coffee is rich.
cards.gram: There are + 복수 + near + 장소. quite a few = 꽤 많은. coffee(음료)는 셀 수 없어서 their coffee is. rich = (맛이) 진한, 깊은.

cards.en: I was nervous before the interview. It's natural.
cards.gram: nervous = 긴장한. It's natural (to be nervous) = 그건 당연해요.

cards.en: Even though I was tired, I pretended to be fine.
cards.gram: even though + 주어 + 동사 = 비록 ~이지만. pretend to + 동사원형 = ~인 척하다.

cards.ko: 드디어 시험이 끝났어요. 정말 오래 기다렸어요.
cards.en: The exam is finally over. It was a long time coming.
cards.gram: a long time coming = 오래 걸려 드디어 이뤄진 일.

cards.ko: 저는 제가 제일 좋아하는 카페에 갔어요.
cards.en: I went to my favourite café.
cards.gram: 장소에 가다는 go to + 장소 (went to). my cafe(내 카페)라고 하면 내가 주인인 카페 → my favourite café.

cards.ko: 차 향기는 저를 편안하게 해 줘요.
cards.en: The smell of tea makes me feel relaxed.
cards.gram: the smell of + 명사 = ~의 향기. make + 사람 + feel + 형용사. 내 기분은 relaxed.

cards.ko: 그 빵 이름이 기억이 안 나요.
cards.en: I can't remember the name of the bread.
cards.gram: ~의 이름은 the name of + 명사. bread name보다 자연스러워요.

cards.en: They're not very different.
cards.gram: different는 형용사라 have 뒤에 못 와요. → They're not (very) different. / They don't have many differences(명사).

cards.en: Prices in Canada are similar to those in Korea.
cards.mine: The price in Canada is similar with Korea.
cards.gram: similar to = ~와 비슷한. 물가는 물가끼리 비교 → those in Korea (= the prices). 물가 전반은 prices(복수) + are.

cards.ko: 성경은 한국어보다 영어로 읽을 때 더 쉽게 이해돼요.
cards.en: I can understand the Bible more easily when I read it in English than in Korean.
cards.mine: I can understand more easier contents.
cards.gram: 동사(understand)를 꾸미는 건 부사 → more easily. contents 대신 the Bible / it. 성경은 대문자 Bible.

cards.ko: 그 책은 제가 소중한 사람이라고 느끼게 해 줘요.
cards.en: The book makes me feel that I am precious.
cards.gram: make + 사람(me) + feel + that 주어+동사. my(내)가 아니라 me(나를)!

cards.ko: 우리 강아지는 항상 더 걷고 싶어 해요.
cards.en: My dog always wants to walk more.
cards.mine: My dog always wants to more walk.
cards.gram: more는 동사 뒤: walk more. My dog은 3인칭 단수라 wants.

cards.ko: 그건 제 스트레스를 줄이는 데 도움이 돼요.
cards.en: It helps me reduce my stress.
cards.mine: It is help me reduce stress.
cards.gram: is와 help를 같이 쓰지 않기(동사는 하나!). help + 사람 + 동사원형.

cards.ko: 그 영화는 무서웠어요. 그래서 저는 겁이 났어요.
cards.en: The movie was scary, so I was scared.
cards.gram: 무섭게 만드는 것은 scary (그 영화가 무서운). 내가 느끼는 기분은 scared (겁먹은).

cards.ko: 저는 보통 저녁에 책을 읽으면서 시간을 보내요.
cards.en: I usually spend my evenings reading.
cards.gram: spend + 시간 + -ing = ~하면서 시간을 보내다.

cards.en: I spend most of my weekends with my family.
cards.gram: spend + 시간 + with 사람 = ~와 시간을 보내다.

cards.ko: 저는 매일 출퇴근하면서 한 시간을 보내요.
cards.en: I spend an hour commuting every day.
cards.gram: spend + 시간 + -ing = ~하면서 시간을 보내다.

cards.ko: 저는 하루에 두 시간씩 영어 공부를 해요.
cards.en: I spend two hours a day studying English.
cards.gram: spend + 시간 + -ing = ~하면서 시간을 보내다.

cards.ko: 어제 오후 내내 방 청소를 했어요.
cards.en: I spent the whole afternoon cleaning my room.
cards.gram: spend + 시간 + -ing = ~하면서 시간을 보내다. spend-spent-spent.

cards.ko: 사람들은 휴대폰을 보면서 너무 많은 시간을 보내요.
cards.en: People spend too much time looking at their phones.
cards.gram: spend + 시간 + -ing = ~하면서 시간을 보내다.

cards.ko: 저는 시험 준비하느라 몇 주를 보냈어요.
cards.en: I spent weeks preparing for the exam.
cards.gram: spend + 시간 + -ing = ~하면서 시간을 보내다. spend-spent-spent.

cards.ko: 저는 휴일에 친구들과 수다 떨면서 시간을 보내는 걸 좋아해요.
cards.en: I love spending time chatting with my friends on holidays.
cards.gram: spend + 시간 + -ing = ~하면서 시간을 보내다.

cards.ko: 아이들은 밖에서 노는 데 시간을 더 써야 해요.
cards.en: Children should spend more time playing outside.
cards.gram: spend + 시간 + -ing = ~하면서 시간을 보내다.

cards.ko: 저는 이번 달에 옷 사는 데 돈을 너무 많이 썼어요.
cards.en: I spent too much money on clothes this month.
cards.gram: 돈은 spend + 돈 + on + 물건. spend-spent-spent.

cards.en: My job keeps me from exercising.
cards.gram: keep + 대상 + from -ing = (주어) 때문에 대상이 ~하지 못하다. from 뒤엔 -ing!

cards.ko: 소음 때문에 잠을 잘 못 자요.
cards.en: The noise keeps me from sleeping well.
cards.gram: keep + 대상 + from -ing = (주어) 때문에 대상이 ~하지 못하다. from 뒤엔 -ing!

cards.ko: 바쁜 일정 때문에 친구들을 못 만나요.
cards.en: My busy schedule keeps me from seeing my friends.
cards.gram: keep + 대상 + from -ing = (주어) 때문에 대상이 ~하지 못하다. from 뒤엔 -ing!

cards.ko: 두려움 때문에 사람들은 새로운 걸 시도하지 못해요.
cards.en: Fear stops people from trying new things.
cards.gram: stop + 대상 + from -ing = (주어) 때문에 대상이 ~하지 못하다. from 뒤엔 -ing!
